Found by the #724 backlog-drain lane (PR #729, 2026-08-17). `bun run scripts/repair-embeddings.ts --global` repaired 1,627 rows but two tables FAILED whole:

- **thoughts**: a leaked `dream_bulk_release_trigger` (a dream-run artifact) raises a forced failure on embedding-repair writes — 1,297 rows still unembedded. Dropping the trigger is destructive DDL, so the lane correctly refused and reported. Needs an operator-sanctioned removal path (or a dream-side teardown fix), then a re-run of the repair for that table.
- **sessions**: `duplicate key value violates unique constraint "idx_sessions_content_hash"` on repair writes — duplicate-content rows collide when the repair path updates them. Needs a dedup/skip decision.

Both failures were isolated per-table by design (the run's per-table fault isolation), so everything else drained. Refs #724, PR #729.
